rgb_note: Spectral-to-XYZ-to-display-RGB conversion may produce negative out-of-gamut RGB components. Positivity is checked in the transported spectral bands when present, not in display RGB.

renderer_metadata.renderer: CYBR SCENES R2 / GEO: stochastic photographic minerals, slope moments, global sky MIS
renderer_metadata.spectral_method: Jointly transported fixed midpoint wavelength quadrature, 25 nm bins
renderer_metadata.steam_model: Authored heterogeneous trilinear density grid; grid-bounded delta and ratio tracking; HG phase
renderer_metadata.sky_model: Single-scattering spherical Rayleigh/aerosol spectral LUT, not reference-validated
renderer_metadata.material_spectra: Reference-illuminant-calibrated RGB-anchor reflectance, not measured mineral spectra
renderer_metadata.cloud_model: Bounded 3D extinction grid; conservative column-majorant DDA; delta-tracked scattering and ratio-tracked shadows
renderer_metadata.leaf_surface_model: Reciprocal Fresnel-GGX coat with two-sided attenuated diffuse body; authored, not measured
renderer_metadata.water_reflection_estimator: Primary: GGX VNDF and solar-disc MIS; indirect: one-root macro reflection manifold with exclusive path ownership
renderer_metadata.underwater_direct_light_approximation: One-root macro-surface manifolds approximate indirect reflected and transmitted caustics; primary reflection uses GGX

scope: Execution, finite radiance, dimensions, traceable geometry; not an aesthetic or physical-reference validation.
